mapper.sql: SELECT q.*, c.name AS customer_name, u.nickname AS create_by_name, o.order_no FROM scm_quotation q JOIN scm_customer c ON c.id = q.customer_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = q.create_by LEFT JOIN scm_order o ON o.id = q.order_id
mapper.select: SELECT i.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit FROM scm_quotation_item i JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id WHERE i.quotation_id = #{quotationId} ORDER BY i.id
